note: Born-digital papers for the figure box call (2026-11-04). Cambridge IGCSE specimen papers, public on cambridgeinternational.org; the PDFs live in the ignored data/question-bank/references/born-digital/<paper>/paper.pdf. Each figure has a hand-set seed region on the 0-1000 page grid; gold_digital.py takes the PDF's drawings, images and words inside it as the figure (labels included, the 'Fig. n' caption and 'NOT TO SCALE' left out) and writes figures.json.
